name: Lead ME Shop-Floor Audit Fixes, Mixed-Material Mass, CAM/PMI & Waterjet Refinement Release
summary: Pro3DWorks v3.2.3 delivers Lead Mechanical Engineer shop-floor accuracy and usability upgrades across metrology, assembly interference, mixed-material mass properties, 19-alloy shop materials, CNC DFM, printability, AP242 PMI & Cp/Cpk tolerance stacks, SendCutSend/OMAX DXF waterjet preflight, SolidWorks meter-to-mm scaling, and dark/720p ergonomics.

highlights.title: Metrology, Section Caps, AP242 PMI & Tolerance Stacks
highlights.text: Open-arc classification, BVH unsegmented face measurement, multi-region body mass and shell-depth cavity preservation, multi-plane Zonal 2D boolean caps with section inertia unit scaling, semantic AP242 PMI priority and common datums, and synchronized tolerance-stack limit conversion.

highlights.title: Importers, Gzip STEP, RFQ Intake & CNC DFM
highlights.text: Quote/comment-aware Part-21 splitting, .step.gz/.stp.gz decompression, unitless BREP detection, rotating-calipers RFQ OBB display in active units, mirror-safe winding in CNC DFM, local pocket entry raycasting, and exact cofactor surface-area draft classification.

highlights.title: PDF-to-DWG Waterjet Studio, Mesh Repair & Fastener Recognition
highlights.text: Full CTM raster compositing, CropBox clipping, ±20° deskew, segment-level web clearance, reference/etch preservation across Overkill & Nesting, auto-injected DXF $INSUNITS/$MEASUREMENT headers, 1e-4 mm default mesh seam welding, and geometry-based hex/SHCS/nut/washer detection.

highlights.title: Desktop CSP, External LGPL OCCT & Fail-Closed Policy
highlights.text: Ships unmodified OCCT 4-GiB files externally under output/occt-resources/ via IPC, removes script-src unsafe-eval and data: script/worker CSP allowances, enforces ::1 loopback and Tauri bridge tokens, preserves offline .lic refresh, and verifies pre-dated clock bounds.

notes: All CAD geometry, RFQ intake, CNC DFM, DXF preflight, Release Review reconciliation, PDF-to-DXF/DWG conversions, and GPU renders run locally on your workstation — zero customer model uploads.
Managed offline mode ('no_external_network') provides technical egress controls and is not a claim of organizational ISO/IEC 27001 certification or TISAX assessment.
OpenCascade / occt-import-js (LGPL-2.1) is shipped in separate relinkable desktop files alongside LICENSE.md; see docs/SBOM.cdx.json.
